tag.name: his6_n
tag.note: Hexahistidine for IMAC. On the N terminus it is cleavable only if a protease site is added; here it is left fused, which is fine for an assay and not for anything injected.

codon_swaps_from_preferred.why: preferred codon created a forbidden motif or a GC-extreme window

what_this_is: A synthesisable open reading frame. Reverse translation is mechanical, so this is a faithful encoding of the designed protein and nothing more -- it carries every uncertainty the design carries.
what_this_is_not: Not evidence the protein folds, is soluble, is active, or is safe. For this target none of those is known at 37 C in tissue, and ordering DNA does not change that.
